resources.string: Reads today’s steps from Health Connect on this device and adds them to your day. Nothing is written back.
Health Connect is not available on this device. Install or update the Health Connect app, then come back.
No steps recorded today in Health Connect.
Imports your runs, rides and walks as cardio.
Strava is not set up on this server yet.
Finish the connection in your browser, then come back here.
The last sync failed. Try again.
Added %1$d steps for today from the phone’s step counter.
Apps sending steps to Health Connect: %1$s. Open that app once so it syncs.
No app sends steps to Health Connect yet. Samsung: Samsung Health → Settings → Health Connect → allow Steps. Other phones: Google Fit → Settings → Sync with Health Connect.
Counts steps with the phone’s own sensor when Health Connect has none. Counting starts once you allow it.
The phone’s step counter is on.
Opens the app settings: Permissions → Physical activity → Don’t allow.
